主要内容: Great American Group (GA), a subsidiary of B. Riley Financial, won the bankruptcy auction for Hancock Fabrics in February 2016. The U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware recognized GA as the successful bidder, and it will manage the going-out-of-business sales for 185 Hancock stores starting April 1, 2016. The sales are expected to last several weeks. Hancock operates approximately 255 retail stores in 37 states and an Internet store. GA has extensive experience working with specialty retailers like Hancock and creditors to manage complex situations. This transaction highlights the synergies of the B. Riley Financial platform, leveraging its industry relationships and consumer retail expertise. B. Riley Financial's Great American Group closed its remaining Hancock Fabric Stores as part of a strategic shift to focus on core operations and optimize resources. The closure is part of a broader restructuring to streamline the retail footprint and enhance efficiency. The company has not provided specific financial details on the impact, but it is anticipated to have a minimal effect on the overall financial performance of B. Riley Financial. The decision reflects the company's commitment to long-term growth and profitability. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include B. Riley Financial, Inc. (RILY), HKFI.
